name: fixes-week
what: The days before Fri Mar 15 opened first, as a person stepping through the days does. The build recorded every day of the month, so a fill may take any day that published, and its row draws the week before as context

name: fixes-sheet
what: Sign-ins, Fri Mar 15: the file came with no rows and the day paused. The decision sheet offers what the sign-in file's ontology allows: carry a good day forward (or back), and replace the file; never a like day (an estimate), never the part alone

name: fixes-pick-fill
what: The fill picked: Thu 14's rows carried forward into Fri 15, stippled; Thu 14 solid, the week before it faded beside it as examples (Sat 9 to Wed 13, recorded by the build); Sat 16, a later day that published, offered to carry back; staged and checked before anything goes out

name: fixes-replace
what: Replace the file on Fri Mar 15: the sign-ins re-sent for the day (a full Friday) is a later delivery of it (ADR 0021 §2, Q-155). It passes its checks and still waits for a decision (Q-183), its story naming the file sent again

text: A later file for Fri 15: auth sent again. It waits for a decision

name: fixes-replace-published
what: The corrected file published as is, with a reason: readers now see Fri 15 as re-sent, and the day is told from the version they got, a normal Friday, not the empty first file (ADR 0021 §1)
